newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-RAIN SHORTENS SRI LANKA TEST WARM-UP IN NZ.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN SHORTENS SRI LANKA TEST WARM-UP IN NZ.

text.p: The opening day of Sri Lanka's three-day first class cricket match against New Zealand A was abandoned on Sunday due to rain.
The loss of the day's play was a blow to the tourists, who begin the first test against New Zealand in Dunedin on Friday. They are now left with at best two days of cricket before the test.
Sri Lanka opened their tour last week by drawing a non-first class two-day match against Northern Districts.
